name: night-shift
title: Night Shift
summary: Dark product UI: near-black layers, crisp sans, one luminous accent and monospaced detail. For SaaS dashboards, developer and AI products, analytics and pro tools.
imagery: Product screenshots on dark backgrounds, charts and code; no stock photos, no neon glows.
rules: Layer depth with bg, surface and raised fills plus 1 px line borders, not shadows.
Headlines in Geist 600 with tight letterSpacing (-0.5 to -1 at 32 px and up); body 14-16 px, weight 400.
Numbers, keys and code in Geist Mono.
The accent marks one primary action, the active state and key data points; text on it uses on-accent.
Muted text for secondary information; never anything dimmer than muted for text.
Radius 10 px for panels and inputs, 6 px for small controls.
No gradients except at most one subtle accent glow per page; no pure black or pure white.
